## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION, not broad risk-off. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Tech weak: XLK in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) while Energy and Utilities leading—XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%); confirmers: broad sector breadth (7/11) and reflation via CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ↑ rising, offset by credit stress signal (HYG/LQD ratio ↓ → credit stress rising).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear mixed: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ↑ rising but labelled complacent in regime signals. Credit stress rising: HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) vs LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) — HYG/LQD ratio trending ↓ falling. Reflation pressure from commodities: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) while TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ↑ rising; UUP in CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%) → flat, so stocks vs bonds (SPY/TLT) remains NEUTRAL.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and defensives both showing strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) showing strength while XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) and XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) showing weakness — style mixed with commodity/value tilt.

**5. US vs Global?**
EM and Japan outperforming pockets of US: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%) and EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%) while China lagging—FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed-to-weak: ARKK in RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%) showing selective thematic bounce, IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -0.72%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) show compressed speculative risk.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation bid intact: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ↑ rising; GLD in RECOVERY (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%) suggesting safe-haven flows alongside reflation.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ↑ rising, while natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND) and long-duration bonds (TLT ABOVE TREND) show consistent 1W/1M strength. DIVERGENCE: Multiple correction patterns across mid/small-cap and cyclicals (XLI CORRECTION 1W: -0.05% | 1M: +7.92%, IJR CORRECTION 1W: -1.47% | 1M: +2.08%) — short-term pullbacks inside broader 1M gains.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor commodity/cyclicals exposure and defensive utilities/REITs given breadth and reflation signals; reduce exposure to China (FXI BELOW TREND) and parts of Tech (XLK BELOW TREND); monitor credit spreads and VXX for shifts in risk tone.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) if commodity momentum holds. BEARISH: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) and XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) if credit signals worsen.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) on reflation. BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) and SLV volatile in RECOVERY (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VIX ~30 (VIX 1W: -1.83% | 1M: +6.13%) is a watch point for risk; Credit spread ~0.72 (Credit Spread 1W: -0.16% | 1M: -1.15%) gauges stress; XLK/XLF ~2.70 (Tech vs Financials 1W: -1.19% | 1M: -1.63%) is pivot for style; SPY/TLT ~7.55 (SPY/TLT 1W: -0.67% | 1M: -5.01%) confirms stock vs bond balance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, reflation bias and mixed risk signals. Energy and Utilities showing relative strength — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%). Key risks: credit-ratio deterioration (HYG/LQD ratio ↓) and Technology/China weakness (XLK BELOW TREND, FXI BELOW TREND) that could force a broader shift if sustained.
